source_gaps: Nickel (028) is absent from both official PSTAR and ASTAR material selectors; no neighboring-element substitution or invented nickel ion table.
STAR does not provide heavy Ni/Cu/Zn recoil-ion or positron stopping in these acquired tables.
No Ni/H compound-specific energy-absorption coefficient or charged-product stopping table acquired; elemental mu_en additivity is formally incorrect (NIST chap3).

No neighboring-element substitution or reconstruction performed.

primary_table_limitations: NIST photon tables omit photonuclear interactions, nuclear-resonance and Delbruck scattering; important photonuclear contributions can occur in the 5-40 MeV giant-resonance region.
Near-edge chemical/phase/temperature fine structure is absent from these elemental photon tables. Hydrogen STAR material is the source gas medium, not interstitial H in nickel.
Interpolation is an explicit table-transfer approximation, not a material-model fit or a reproduced native NIST interpolation.
missing_material_inputs: Exclusive emitted spectra/branch populations and matching actual reaction rates, not inclusive cross sections or AME Q alone.
Measured finite sample geometry, source position/direction distributions and Ni/H composition/phase; periodic 4^3 lattice is not an absorber.
Secondary photon and charged transport, containment and thermalization; compound-specific coefficients where needed.
